theorems.name: Submission.slicing_mb_cdb_band_measure_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (K : Set (Eucl P)) (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), IsClosed K → ContinuousOn f K → μ K < ∞ → Tendsto (fun j : ℕ => μ (K ∩ f ⁻¹' Ioo (a - 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1)) (b + 1 / ((j : ℝ) + 1)))) atTop (𝓝 (μ (K ∩ f ⁻¹' Icc a b)))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
